authorization.scope: User authorizes independently measured quantities for a calibrated BHSM prediction, superseding older no-measured-input policy. Muon anomaly, g_mu and discrepancy-inferred native correction remain excluded.

fermi_matching_scope.radiative_terms_source: MuLan2013 pp27-28: rounded one-loop and two-loop corrections, including finite-electron-mass contribution at two loops.
fermi_matching_scope.reference_rematch_formula: GF_ref*(m_mu_ref/m_mu)^2.5*sqrt(hbar_new/hbar_ref), with residual R_ref/R_new set1 only for this comparison.
fermi_matching_scope.remaining_matching: Recompute reference corrections with selected alpha and masses; account for any BHSM contribution to the lifetime matching. This input config makes no complete GF theory/native uncertainty claim.
fermi_matching_scope.rounding_bound_scope: Sum of0.05ppm half-last-digit intervals for the two rounded radiative terms; excludes theory truncation and change of extraction inputs.

matching_equations.fixed_family_constraint: M_l_tree=v*Y_l_fixed/sqrt(2); three measured masses do not authorize three independent Yukawas.
matching_equations.required_corrections: Pole locations, residues, charge normalization, BHSM and radiative matching corrections remain to be calculated. The candidate tree scalar equations are not exact precision matching.

R_infinity.extraction_assumptions: Bound-state QED and hydrogen line-shift model; uses charge universality. It is not a global muonium/muon-anomaly-adjusted mass. The published Rb alpha has its own Rydberg input; this configuration does not claim an exact re-adjustment of the recoil primitives.
R_infinity.method: Hydrogen2S-4P plus1S-2S spectroscopy, joint R_infinity/proton-radius extraction.

alpha_inverse_0.extraction_assumptions: Uses atomic mass ratios and Rydberg constant. Bound-electron QED enters A_r(e); this is not free-electron-anomaly or muon-anomaly extraction. Shared metrology dependencies require covariance when precision warrants.

higgs_mass.extraction_assumptions: Invariant-mass peak fits with detector calibration, signal/background and interference modeling. Published channel/run correlations are already included; retain reported rounded total0.11GeV. Matching a measured resonance mass to a BHSM pole/curvature requires its radiative corrections.

muon_electron_mass_ratio.extraction_assumptions: Assumes equal magnitude muon/electron charge and bound-state QED. Centroid extraction applies976.4MHz hyperfine and0.8MHz quadratic-Doppler corrections. The reported magnetic-moment-derived ratio is comparison only and is not selected.
muon_electron_mass_ratio.method: Optical muonium1S-2S gross-structure measurement and QED extraction.

positive_muon_lifetime.extraction_assumptions: Published lifetime combines two stopping-target runs with their correlations. Decay-rate matching assumes V-A Fermi theory with reference radiative corrections; no muon anomaly value is used as a target.

tau_mass.extraction_assumptions: Three-pion pseudomass endpoint with fitted estimator-bias correction, beam-energy and momentum calibration, ISR/FSR and decay simulation. Experimental mass interpretation is not a computed BHSM residue or external mode.

CODATA2022_electron_mass_reference.note: Global adjusted electron mass shares alpha/Rydberg/bound-electron-QED metrology; the global alpha adjustment also uses the free-electron anomaly. It must not be treated as independent of selected recoil alpha. This configuration instead derives the selected electron mass from its stated primary spectroscopy/recoil inputs.

CODATA2022_muon_electron_ratio.reason: Sec.IX Eq.(185) contains (1+a_mu)*m_e/m_mu in the muonium magnetic term; a_mu and mass ratio are adjusted jointly. The optical gross-structure ratio avoids selecting this magnetic-moment calibration.

electron_atomic_mass_reference.note: Bound-carbon-electron spin/cyclotron ratio with bound-state QED and binding-energy correction. Relevant to recoil alpha metrology; no muon anomaly target.

uncertainty_and_correlations.correlation_upper_scope: Input-only linear standard-uncertainty upper bound over |rho_ij|<=1; not a probability interval or a rigorous observable enclosure.
uncertainty_and_correlations.cross_source_covariance_status: Not established. Rb recoil, spectroscopy and electron-mass metrology share constants and theory; tau/Higgs calibration may share reference masses. Missing correlations are not asserted zero.
uncertainty_and_correlations.illustrative_matrix_scope: First-order propagation assuming independent selected primitives and fixed rounded radiative terms. It retains exact derived mass/GF dependence, but is not the measured cross-source covariance or a complete theory/native error budget.
uncertainty_and_correlations.important_dependency: GF varies as m_mu^-5/2 at fixed lifetime and decay correction. m_mu shares m_e through the optical ratio, so GF, muon and electron masses must not be treated as three independent measured inputs.
uncovered_errors: Potential BHSM effects in atomic/lifetime matching
Native Pauli contribution and overlap subtraction
Numerical, angular/temporal truncation and soft-transfer errors

unit_convention.mass: GeV/c^2; c=1 when passed to field theory
